'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
***[[Kabul Airlift (2021)|2021 evacuation from Afghanistan]]
****[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
*****American flights carrying evacuees from [[Afghanistan]] are temporarily suspended following four cases of [[measles]] in [[Afghan refugees]] arriving in the [[United States]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/politics/articles/2021-09-10/us-afghan-evacuee-flights-halted-from-two-key-bases (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
*****[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] announces that 21 [[Americans]] have been evacuated from [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-citizens-evacuated-afghanistan-taliban-departures/ (CBS News)]
***[[List of drone strikes in Afghanistan]]
****Footage released by ''[[The New York Times]]'' shows that a U.S. drone strike conducted [[August 2021 Kabul drone strike|on August 29]] targeted an aid worker named Zemari Ahmadi instead of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant – Khorasan Province|ISIS-K]] militants. The report also confirms that 10 Afghans were killed in the drone strike, including seven children. [https://www.businessinsider.com/us-drone-strike-targeted-aid-worker-killing-10-afghan-civilians-2021-9 (''Business Insider'')]
**[[2021 Afghan protests]]
***The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] says that the [[Taliban]] response to the peaceful marches has been increasingly violent, with authorities using live ammunition, batons and whips, which has resulted in the deaths of four civilians. A spokesperson for the rights office says that the response from the Taliban has been "unfortunately severe". [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/taliban-response-afghan-protests-increasingly-violent-un-says-2021-09-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[2021 Guinean coup d'état]]
**The [[African Union]] suspends [[Guinea]] in response to last week's [[Coup d'état|military coup]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/09/10/african-union-suspends-guinea-following-coup/ (Africanews)]
*[[Iran–PJAK conflict]]
**[[Iran]]ian [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Ground Forces|IRGC Ground Forces]] strike "terrorist positions" in northern [[Iraq]] with suicide and [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|combat drones]] as well as precision-guided artillery. [https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/464900/IRGC-strikes-terrorist-positions-in-northern-Iraq (''Tehran Times'')] [https://iranintl.com/en/iran/tehran-readying-assault-iranian-kurdish-groups-iraq (Iran International)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[LGBT rights in Africa]]
**A forum for the promotion of [[LGBT rights]] is hosted in [[Kigali]], [[Rwanda]], in order to address [[minority rights]]. At the forum, a [[Rwandans|Rwandan]] man describes being assaulted by family members when he [[Coming out|came out]] as [[gay]]. The forum also documented and urged the governments of [[Tanzania]], [[Uganda]], [[Burundi]] and [[Kenya]] to decriminalize [[homosexuality]] and protect the minority. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/magazine/minorities-still-face-discrimination-despite-rights-laws-3545028 (''The EastAfrican'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021 Guinean coup d'état]]
**In response to [[Guinea]]'s expulsion from the [[Economic Community of West African States]], the [[National Committee of Reconciliation and Development|military junta]] freezes all [[government of Guinea|government]] assets in the [[Central Bank of the Republic of Guinea]] in order to "preserve the country's interest". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/guinea-junta-freezes-state-assets-as-regional-officials-come/2021/09/10/246ea732-1239-11ec-baca-86b144fc8a2d_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*''[[Epic Games v. Apple]]''
**[[United States federal judge|United States District Judge]] [[Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers]] rules that [[Apple Inc.]] cannot stop [[mobile app]] developers from directing users to third-party payment options, issuing a permanent injunction against the company. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-58522588 (BBC News)]
*[[Russia]]'s [[Gazprom]] says that it has completed the construction of the [[Nord Stream#Nord Stream 2|Nord Stream 2]] [[natural gas]] [[Pipeline transport|pipeline]] to [[Germany]]. Gazprom says that gas flows to Europe through the pipeline cannot begin until they have received approval from German regulators. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russias-gazprom-says-it-has-completed-nord-stream-2-construction-2021-09-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Guerrero earthquake]]
**A [[landslide]] occurs at [[Tlalnepantla de Baz|Tlalnepantla]], [[State of Mexico]], on the hill known as [[Cerro del Chiquihuite]], killing one person and leaving three more missing. It is said that the landslide was triggered by the earthquake in Guerrero three days earlier, which weakened soil conditions on the hill. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-09-10/landslide-crashes-into-homes-on-outskirts-of-mexico-city?fbclid=IwAR3a5dKMpGFWIfNUWrUGo3_md7YjLgDKZBwu_5QnQpg_MsEddXPVeeWwTMc (''U.S. News & World Report'')] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/search-mexico-hill-collapse-slowed-fears-landslides-79967659 (ABC News)]
*Two people are killed and nine others are injured after a powerful [[whirlwind]] hits [[Pantelleria]], [[Sicily]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-58524714 (BBC News)] 
*A 44-year-old firefighter dies during efforts to contain a [[wildfire]] in [[Province of Málaga|Málaga]], [[Spain]], which has triggered the evacuation of 939 people from [[Estepona]] and [[Benahavis]]. Residents of [[Jubrique]] and [[Genalguacil]] are ordered to stay indoors and close their windows due to the risk posed by an overhead [[Flammagenitus cloud|fire cloud]] that could rain down hot matter in the area. [https://www.itv.com/news/2021-09-10/mlaga-wildfires-firefighter-killed-as-more-than-900-evacuated-from-area (''ITV News'')]  [https://english.elpais.com/spain/2021-09-10/firefighter-killed-during-efforts-to-control-wildfires-in-malaga-province.html (''El País'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] surpasses 1,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://m.akipress.com/news:662380:Mongolia_confirmed_2,009_new_daily_coronavirus_cases,_15_deaths/ (AKIpress News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports 568 new locally transmitted cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since August 2020. [https://www.todayonline.com/singapore/covid-19-568-new-locally-transmitted-cases-singapore-1-5-are-seniors-aged-over-60 (''Today'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****Visitors to the upcoming [[Expo 2020]] event in [[Dubai]] will not be required to show proof of vaccination or be [[COVID-19 testing|tested]] for COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/9/10/no-proof-of-vaccines-or-tests-required-to-enter-dubai-expo (Al Jazeera English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Vietnam]]
****The [[Vietnam]]ese [[Ministry of Health (Vietnam)|Ministry of Health]] issues a conditional approval of the [[Sinopharm BIBP COVID-19 vaccine|Hayat-Vax COVID-19 vaccine]] for emergency use in the country. [https://en.vietnamplus.vn/vietnam-conditionally-approves-hayatvax-for-emergency-use/207787.vnp (VietnamPlus)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
****[[Denmark]] becomes the first country in the [[European Union]] to lift all of its COVID-19-related restrictions, with the lifting of the requirement to show a digital pass in order to enter nightclubs, as the country no longer considers COVID-19 to be a "socially critical" disease and the [[COVID-19 vaccination in Denmark|vaccination rate]] has surpassed 80%. [https://www.theguardian.com/weather/2021/sep/10/denmark-lifts-all-covid-restrictions-as-vaccinations-top-80-per-cent (''The Guardian'')] [https://apnews.com/article/europe-health-coronavirus-pandemic-epidemics-denmark-58f504553ea4c54bb5ae129e74989625 (Associated Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Germany]]
****The [[Standing Committee on Vaccination]] recommends that pregnant or breastfeeding women in [[Germany]] should be vaccinated two doses against COVID-19 using [[mRNA]]-based vaccines from the second trimester of [[pregnancy]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/top-news/articles/2021-09-10/germany-recommends-covid-19-vaccinations-for-pregnant-women (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record 1,542 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/nsw-records-nine-covid-deaths-as-cases-rise-c-3924771 (''Seven News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mauritius]]
****Former Prime Minister [[Navin Ramgoolam]] is airlifted to India for treatment of COVID-19. [https://www.en.etemaaddaily.com/world/international/former-mauritius-pm-navin-ramgoolam-moves-to-india-for-covid-treatment:101036 (''Etemaad'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Togo]]
****[[Togo]] closes all [[place of worship|places of worship]] and bans all cultural, sporting and political events, including weddings and funerals, following an increase in the number of new COVID-19 cases in recent weeks. [https://www.barrons.com/news/togo-shuts-churches-mosques-as-covid-19-cases-climb-01631277908 (''Barron's'')]
*[[France]] raises its [[bird flu]] alert level to "moderate" after a severe strain of the virus was reported this week at a private household in the [[Ardennes (department)|Ardennes department]], near the border with [[Belgium]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/09/10/france-raises-bird-flu-alert-level-after-severe-form-of-virus-detected (Euronews)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brexit and the Irish border]]
**The [[European Union]] rejects a request from the [[United Kingdom]] to renegotiate the deal governing the trading position of [[Northern Ireland]]. The EU adds that renegotiating the deal, which agreed to leave some EU rules in place in Northern Ireland and to accept checks on goods arriving from elsewhere in the UK following [[Brexit]], would result in "instability, uncertainty and unpredictability in Northern Ireland". [https://news.yahoo.com/eu-rejects-reworking-n-ireland-142225379.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2019 Trump–Ukraine scandal]]
**Former [[Rudy Giuliani]] associate [[Igor Fruman]] pleads guilty to one count of soliciting a contribution by a foreign national. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2021/09/10/igor-fruman-former-rudy-giuliani-associate-pleads-guilty/5570899001/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
**Former [[Minister of Health (France)|French health minister]] [[Agnès Buzyn]] is charged by the ''[[Cour de Justice de la République]]'' with "endangering the lives of others" over her handling of the pandemic. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/french-ex-health-minister-charged-over-handling-of-covid-19-pandemic (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*A new [[government of Lebanon|government]] is formed in [[Lebanon]], with [[Najib Mikati]] becoming [[Prime Minister of Lebanon]] for the third time. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/10/middleeast/lebanon-new-government-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Venko Filipče]], the health minister of [[North Macedonia]], resigns, claiming moral responsibility for the fire that occurred at a [[field hospital]] in [[Tetovo]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/north-macedonian-health-minister-resigns-over-deadly-covid-hospital-fire/2361664 (Anadolu Agency)]

'''Religion and politics'''

**The 2021 Dismantling Global Hindutva conference, or the DGH, held between 10-12 September, apparently started out as a small group of academics planning a modest gathering to explore the dangers of Hindutva ideology.
